title: Non-opening Claude command identities named inside a self-started turn are not retired when it closes
outcome: Identities that are not TermAl's (a second wake-up S2 whose started arrives mid-turn, or one named by the closing result) are retired when the self-started turn closes, or the reason they cannot occur is documented, so a late lone frame naming them cannot open and adopt a phantom turn on an idle session.
acceptance: After a self-started turn closes, a late lone frame naming a non-prompt identity seen in that turn or named by its result opens no turn and adopts nothing; covered by a test, or the impossibility is documented in src/claude_turn_ownership.rs's contract.
The maintained full gate passes on the change.
